name: Jarvis
changes_cs: Jarvis přidal filtrovaný WDUi extension audit: read-only dialog nad audit logem pro extension a skill akce, s detailem parametrů, výsledků a potvrzovacího stavu. Extension manager z něj umí audit otevřít bez přidání nových exekučních práv.
changes_en: Jarvis added a filtered WDUi extension audit: a read-only dialog over the audit log for extension and skill actions, with parameter, result, and confirmation-state detail. The extension manager can open it without adding new execution privileges.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis přidal první WDUi extension manager: read-only dialog pro manifesty, policy verdicty a deklarované tooly, plus bezpečná tlačítka pro detail, policy check a tool listing. Enable/disable se pořád jen připraví jako explicitní --confirm příkaz.
history.changes_en: Jarvis added the first WDUi extension manager: a read-only dialog for manifests, policy verdicts, and declared tools, plus safe buttons for detail, policy check, and tool listing. Enable/disable is still only prepared as an explicit --confirm command.

history.changes_cs: Přidaná první bezpečná read-only connector tool vrstva: manifesty mohou deklarovat tools[], Jarvis je umí vypsat přes /extension-tools a potvrzeně zavolat lokální nebo privátní HTTP GET přes /extension-call bez spouštění cizího kódu a bez odesílání workspace kontextu.
history.changes_en: Added the first safe read-only connector tool layer: manifests can declare tools[], Jarvis can list them with /extension-tools and, with confirmation, call local or private HTTP GET tools through /extension-call without launching foreign code or sending workspace context.

history.changes_cs: Jarvis rozsiruje crash recovery: job journal uklada obnovitelny prompt, /recovery-export vytvari Markdown report a /recovery-requeue <id> --confirm umi znovu zaradit jen bezpecne read-only/model-only joby; rizikove akce se po padu nereplayuji.
history.changes_en: Jarvis extends crash recovery: the job journal stores a recoverable prompt, /recovery-export writes a Markdown report, and /recovery-requeue <id> --confirm can requeue only safe read-only/model-only jobs; risky actions are not replayed after a crash.

history.changes_cs: Pridana prvni bezpecna extension registry vrstva pro lokalni pluginy, skills, MCP a app connectory. Jarvis umi extension najit, zobrazit manifest a explicitne povolit nebo zakazat, zatim bez spousteni extension.
history.changes_en: Added the first safe extension registry layer for local plugins, skills, MCP servers, and app connectors. Jarvis can discover extensions, show manifests, and explicitly enable or disable them, without executing extensions yet.

history.changes_cs: Fronta workeru jde ted ovladat jemneji: /queue ukazuje cekajici joby s ID, /cancel rusi jen aktualni job, /queue-cancel zrusi jeden cekajici job a /queue-clear vymaze cekajici frontu bez sestrelovani bezici prace.
history.changes_en: Worker queue control is now more precise: /queue lists waiting jobs with IDs, /cancel cancels only the current job, /queue-cancel removes one waiting job, and /queue-clear clears waiting work without killing the running job.
